text:
Platinum Price in 1992
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1992, the LBMA platinum price rose 1.9% between 1992-01-31 ($348) and 1992-12-30 ($355). The highest sampled price was $385 in July and the lowest was $345 in April. The mean of these observations was $362. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
